Summary

PRVCICS1 is an online CICS transaction program (transaction ID: PINQ) that supports a Provider Inquiry function for state analysts. It accepts a National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered on a green-screen BMS map, reads the Provider Master VSAM file to retrieve the provider's record, and returns the provider's enrollment status (Active, Terminated, Pending, or Denied) along with their risk tier information to the analyst's screen.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM (CICS PRVPROVN) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: NPI Session Continuity - Retrieve the previously entered NPI from the communication area when the analyst returns to the inquiry screen, enabling seamless continuation of the provider lookup session without re-entering the NPI 2: Analyst NPI Input Capture - Accept the National Provider Identifier (NPI) entered by the state analyst on the PINQ provider inquiry screen (PRVMAP1) to initiate a provider lookup 3: Provider Master Record Lookup - Search the Provider Master file using the entered NPI as the unique key to retrieve the provider's enrollment record and associated details 4: Provider Not Found Handling - When no provider record matches the entered NPI, generate a 'Provider Not Found' message to inform the analyst that the NPI does not exist in the system 5: Provider Enrollment Status Determination - Evaluate the provider's status flags from the retrieved record and classify the provider's enrollment status as one of four states: ACTIVE, TERMINATED, PENDING, or DENIED 6: Active Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'ACTIVE' when the provider's active status flag is set, indicating the provider is currently enrolled and eligible 7: Terminated Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'TERMINATED' when the provider's terminated status flag is set, indicating the provider's enrollment has been ended 8: Pending Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'PENDING' when the provider's pending status flag is set, indicating the provider's enrollment application is under review 9: Denied Provider Identification - Identify and label a provider as 'DENIED' when none of the active, terminated, or pending flags are set, indicating the provider's enrollment was denied 10: Provider Inquiry Results Display - Send the provider's enrollment status and record details back to the analyst's PINQ screen (PRVMAP1), presenting the retrieved provider information for review 11: Transaction Session Persistence - Return control to the PINQ transaction while retaining the NPI in the communication area, keeping the inquiry session active and ready for the next provider lookup

High level flow diagram

Business Rules

Supporting Code

NPI Session Continuity-L_3: ```cobol IF EIBCALEN > 0 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-NPI-IN END-IF ``` Analyst NPI Input Capture on Provider Inquiry Screen-L_6: ```cobol EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('PRVMAP1') MAPSET('PRVSET1') RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC ``` Provider Master Record Lookup by NPI-L_9: ```cobol EXEC CICS READ FILE('PRVPROVN') INTO(WS-PROVIDER-AREA) RIDFLD(WS-NPI-IN) RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC ``` Provider Not Found Handling-L_15: ```cobol WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) MOVE 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' TO WS-MSG ``` Provider Enrollment Status Determination-L_14: ```cobol EVALUATE WS-RESP WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) PERFORM FORMAT-PROVIDER ``` Active Provider Identification-L_24: ```cobol WHEN PRV-ACTIVE OF WS-PROVIDER-AREA MOVE 'ACTIVE' TO WS-MSG ``` Terminated Provider Identification-L_26: ```cobol WHEN PRV-TERMINATED OF WS-PROVIDER-AREA MOVE 'TERMINATED' TO WS-MSG ``` Pending Provider Identification-L_28: ```cobol WHEN PRV-PENDING OF WS-PROVIDER-AREA MOVE 'PENDING' TO WS-MSG ``` Denied Provider Identification-L_30: ```cobol WHEN OTHER MOVE 'DENIED' TO WS-MSG ``` Provider Inquiry Results Display to Analyst-L_19: ```cobol EXEC CICS SEND MAP('PRVMAP1') MAPSET('PRVSET1') FROM(WS-PROVIDER-AREA) RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC ``` Transaction Session Persistence and NPI Retention-L_23: ```cobol EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('PINQ') COMMAREA(WS-NPI-IN) END-EXEC ```

1: NPI Session Continuity

Business Rules

Supporting Code

NPI_Session_Continuity_Check-L_2: ```cobol IF EIBCALEN > 0 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-NPI-IN END-IF ``` NPI_Retrieval_from_Session-L_3: ```cobol MOVE DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-NPI-IN ```

2: Analyst NPI Input Capture

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Rule Pre-Population of NPI from Previous Inquiry Session-L2: ```cobol IF EIBCALEN > 0 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-NPI-IN END-IF ``` Rule System Captures NPI Input Entered by Analyst on PRVMAP1 Screen-L4: ```cobol EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('PRVMAP1') MAPSET('PRVSET1') RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC ``` Rule NPI Successfully Captured and Ready for Provider Master Record Lookup-L4: ```cobol EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('PRVMAP1') MAPSET('PRVSET1') RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC EXEC CICS READ FILE('PRVPROVN') INTO(WS-PROVIDER-AREA) RIDFLD(WS-NPI-IN) RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC ``` Rule NPI Input Not Received — Analyst Must Re-Enter NPI-L4: ```cobol EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('PRVMAP1') MAPSET('PRVSET1') RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC ```

3: Provider Master Record Lookup

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Rule NPI Used as Unique Provider Lookup Key-L4: ```cobol RIDFLD(WS-NPI-IN) ``` Rule Provider Master File Search by NPI-L1_L6: ```cobol EXEC CICS READ FILE('PRVPROVN') INTO(WS-PROVIDER-AREA) RIDFLD(WS-NPI-IN) RESP(WS-RESP) END-EXEC ``` Rule Provider Record Successfully Retrieved for Status Evaluation-L7_L9: ```cobol EVALUATE WS-RESP WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) PERFORM FORMAT-PROVIDER END-EVALUATE ``` Rule No Matching Provider Record Found for Entered NPI-L10_L11: ```cobol EVALUATE WS-RESP WHEN DFHRESP(NOTFND) MOVE 'PROVIDER NOT FOUND' TO WS-MSG END-EVALUATE ```

11: Transaction Session Persistence

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Preserve Current NPI in Session Memory for Next Lookup-L_line_number: ```cobol EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('PINQ') COMMAREA(WS-NPI-IN) END-EXEC ``` Keep Inquiry Session Active and Ready on PINQ Screen-L_line_number: ```cobol EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('PINQ') COMMAREA(WS-NPI-IN) END-EXEC ``` NPI Available for Next Search Without Re-entry-L_line_number: ```cobol IF EIBCALEN > 0 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-NPI-IN END-IF ``` Session Remains Open on PINQ Screen While Awaiting Analyst Action-L_line_number: ```cobol EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID('PINQ') COMMAREA(WS-NPI-IN) END-EXEC ```
